connect.title: Connect LinkedIn
connect.intro: Sign in wid di LinkedIn account weh manage yuh ads. Leadrat only read yuh ad accounts, Lead Gen Form leads an ad statistics, an send conversions yuh switch on.
connect.need1: A role pan di LinkedIn ad account (Viewer or higher).
connect.need2: A role pan di linked company page (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator or Analyst) - LinkedIn require it fi share leads.
connect.need3: A phone numba kweschan pan yuh Lead Gen Forms - leads widout a phone numba cyaan be added.

connection.title: Connection
connection.syncResult: Sync done: {{received}} received, {{created}} created, {{duplicates}} duplicate, {{rejected}} rejected.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect LinkedIn ? Syncing stop an di access tokens dem get delete. Leads, statistics an di activity log dem keep.
connection.noPermission: Yuh can view dis page. Fi connect an change settings need di "Manage Settings" permission.
connection.fetchHint: New leads dem check every few minutes an di last 7 days dem re-check evri day, so notn no miss. Yuz dis fi leads fram before yuh connect, or fi check a period again (up to 90 days at a time). Leads already inna Leadrat dem skip.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Tell LinkedIn which a dem leads become real prospects. Wen a LinkedIn lead reach a status yuh choose below, Leadrat report it to LinkedIn , so yuh campaign reports show lead quality an LinkedIn can find more people like yuh bes leads. Only di LinkedIn lead ID an a one-way hash a di email dem sen.
